purpose: Apply the already frozen two-class common AP core to the complete immutable prediction archive. This is distinct from ten-class native BDD AP and native KITTI difficulty/AP_R40.
request_schema: common_archive_scoring_request_v1: dataset(bdd or kitti), archive_path, archive_manifest_sha256, archive_complete_sha256, all five local source/policy hashes, annotation_views mapping each required variant to path/SHA256.
integrity: Verify completed archive hashes and every archived prediction, all annotation hashes, exact image metadata/order, fixed category mapping and annotation-policy binding. Verify that the KITTI ordinary targets are identical after removing annotation IDs. One common prediction projection is used for both KITTI views; save its SHA256 in both results.
metric: Unchanged common_ap_core.py with isolated pinned pycocotools2.0.11, two classes(person0,car2), IoU.50:.05:.95,101recall levels, all areas/maxDet300. Preserve classwise AP-by-IoU,101precision curves and max-recall curves. Raw all-class predictions remain in the archive; mapping occurs only after original ten-class NMS.
completion: Exclusive output lock and all-variant directory commit. Write no completed score set until every required variant succeeds and input/source integrity is rechecked. Interrupted partial directories are retained. Existing completed matching results are hash-verified and reused without invoking the evaluator; different/corrupt input or output bytes are rejected.
synthetic_validation: Fabricated labels/predictions only, with an empty second image, a low-score zero-area prediction and a non-target-class prediction. Known answers: common source-ignore AP1.0, strict/no-ignore AP0.5, BDD-common AP0.5. These are software fixtures, not detector results. Both KITTI variants share the exact projection; all6original detections/5mapped detections retained. Missing variant, changed source, changed annotations and changed output are rejected. A failing evaluator mock proves completed scores are reused without recomputation.
limits: This validates common-score integration only. GPU inference preflight, native BDD final-evaluation runner, native KITTI archive export/scoring integration, final48endpoint model roster and full real-data evaluation/analysis are still pending. The common metric does not erase annotation/ignore differences or establish a causal explanation of cross-dataset effects.
